input.stem: In an industrial wastewater treatment facility, an electrolytic cell (Cell 1) containing 50000.0 g of wastewater with copper(II) ions at a concentration of 254.16 ppm (by mass) is connected in series with Cell 2 containing an aqueous solution of chromium(III) sulfate. Exhaustive electrolysis is carried out such that all the copper(II) ions in Cell 1 are completely reduced to metallic copper. Under these conditions, the equivalent mass of the substance in cell 1 is 31.77 g eq⁻¹, the equivalent mass of the substance in cell 2 is 17.33 g eq⁻¹, and the molar mass of the compound deposited in Cell 2 is 52.0 g mol⁻¹. Determine the total amount of chromium deposited at the cathode of Cell 2. Give the answer in mol.
